title: TcServiceConfiguration
description: The configuration of a telecommand service shared between user and provider.

ServiceProviderAddress.title: ServiceProviderAddress
ServiceProviderAddress.description: Address or DNS name of the gRPC server hosting the CDDS TC Service Provider. The IP address configuration is only needed for the CDDS TC Service User.

serviceProvider.description: The name of the service provider organization providing the TC service

terminal.description: Optional: The name of the terminal providing the CDDS service

address.description: The IP address or DNS resolve able name of the gRPC provider. For a provider the address can be omitted.

port.description: The TCP port of the gRPC provider

rootCertificateFile.description: The trust anchor / root certificate use to sign the CDDS user / CDDS provider certificates

certificateFile.description: The certificate file of the CDDS user or the CDDS provider

privateKeyFile.description: The private key file of the CDDS user or the CDDS provider

TcServiceEndpoint.title: TcServiceEndpoint
TcServiceEndpoint.description: Allows the identification of a service endpoint in terms of the parameters provided below.

endpointName.description: An optional endpoint name to distinguish endpoints; for instance for spacecrafts supporting multiple bands.

serviceVersion.description: The CDDS service version of this service

serviceProvider.description: The name of the service provider organization providing the TC service

terminal.description: The name of the terminal providing the TC service

serviceUser.description: The service user (spacecraft) for which TC shall be delivered

cltu.description: If the cltu filed is set to true, the endpoint supports CLTUs.

gvcIds.description: If the GVCIDs field is set, the endpoint supports TC frames conforming to the specified GVCIDs.

not.description: Indicates the use of the endpoint for uplink of CLTU, or a TC VC when the TC User provides TC frames for transmission; the endpoint is requested either for CLTU uplink or for the uplink of TC frames for the specified GVCIDs.
